abstract: A case of müllerian pseudohermaphroditism in a male subject with a uterus is described. The patient showed normal secondary sex characteristics as well as normal external genitalia, except for right cryptorchidism and a painful tumoral mass in the left testis. Examination of surgical specimens revealed a uterus attached to the left ductus deferens. Areas of seminoma and embryonal carcinoma were present in the left testis. In addition, there was a thin insufficiently collagenized albuginea that contained a cellular connective tissue resembling the ovarian stroma, as well as hypoplastic and atrophic seminiferous tubules. In the testicular parenchyma most of the seminiferous tubules located far away from the tumor possessed the atypical malignant germ cells characteristic of intratubular undifferentiated germ cell tumors. No spermatogenesis was seen. The right abdominal testis was atrophic and showed a normal albuginea. However, there was an undifferentiated germ cell tumor similar to that observed in the left testis. We describe the first case of a tumor in a scrotal testis of a male subject with a uterus. The occurrence of this tumor is discussed with regard to tubular dysgenesis present in both testes and supported by the intrinsically abnormal germ cells as well as by the immature Sertoli cells found in both testes.
abstract_ja: ミュラー管性偽半陰陽で子宮を有する男性の症例を報告する。患者は正常な二次性徴と正常な外性器を示したが、右側の停留精巣と左精巣の疼痛を伴う腫瘤があった。手術標本の検査では、左精巣の精管に子宮が付着していた。左精巣にはセミノーマと胎児性癌の領域が認められた。さらに、卵巣間質に類似した細胞性結合組織を含む、薄く十分にコラーゲン化していない白膜があり、低形成で萎縮した精細管も認められた。腫瘍から離れた精細管の多くには、管内未分化胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な異型性の悪性胚細胞が認められた。精子形成は認められなかった。右の腹腔内精巣は萎縮し、正常な白膜を示した。しかし、左精巣と同様の未分化胚細胞腫瘍が存在した。子宮を有する男性の陰嚢内精巣に生じた腫瘍は本例が初めての報告であり、両精巣に存在する精細管形成異常と、両精巣で見られた本質的に異常な胚細胞および未熟なセルトリ細胞に基づき、この腫瘍の発生について考察する。
